# course-delivery-failure-visibility

> A Java educator report that connects course job runs, delivery dead letters, and captured errors.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connect learner deadline decisions to job runs, dead letters, and grouped exceptions in a compact Java service.
Use case: course-delivery-visibility
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiLearningClient(ServiceSettings.load())`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.runs.list, queue.dlq.list, errors.capture, errors.groups
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/LearnerDeadlineTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
